name: Victor Love
description: '''Vittorio D'Amore''', professionally known by his [[Anglicisation of names|anglicized name]] '''Victor Love''', is an Italian multi-instrumentalist, [[Programming (music)|music programmer]], [[sound engineer]] and composer. He first came to prominence as founder and [[frontman]] of the  [[industrial rock]] band [[Dope Stars Inc.]] in 2003. He has since started multiple solo music projects, particularly the prolific [[chiptune]]-[[synth metal]] project '''Master Boot Record'''.{{efn|Stylized in [[all-caps]] as {{gloss|'''MASTER BOOT RECORD'''}}}}
